blurb: Guests can enjoy waterpark attractions and reserve shaded picnic areas with picnic tables and charcoal grills. The park operates daily from 12 pm to 6 pm during July and August. Refunds and rain checks are not issued for inclement weather, but rescheduling may be attempted.
extraNote: Payments must be made with a contract and are non-refundable · Refunds and rain checks for daily admission tickets will not be issued for any reason, including inclement weather or park closures · In the event of inclement weather, the park will attempt to reschedule the date of your visit · Guests will not be allowed to enter prior to 12 pm · July through August
